notes:
PLEASE READ THIS FIRST if you already have the app installed: use the Setup file below ONCE, rather than the Updates button. The Updates button in every version up to and including 1.8.0 had a fault that wrote the new version into the wrong folder, so afterwards it looked like your settings, your saved characters and your calibration had all vanished. Nothing was ever lost, it was all still sitting in the real folder, but the app you were looking at could not see it. Running the Setup file puts you on 1.8.1 and keeps everything you already have. From 1.8.1 onward the Updates button works properly, so this is a one time thing.

What is fixed in this version.

F8 starts the tool again. Press F8 to stop, then hold F8 for about a second to start again. Before this, a start press in the first second or two after a stop was thrown away, so it looked like F8 only worked one way. The window now shows HOLD F8 while you are holding it, so you can see it counting.

Holding F8 too long can no longer restart the tool. Holding it for about two seconds used to stop the tool and then start it again on the very same press, so you would let go believing you had your keyboard back while it was already sending keys again. That cannot happen now.

A fast row can no longer interrupt a spell. Auto Loot, and any row set faster than two seconds, could cancel a buff that was part way through being cast. All of them now wait for the cast to finish, which they were always supposed to do.

Undo load gives you back the right character. It was picking the wrong saved copy and could hand you a character from days earlier while telling you it had worked.

Mode Ready calibration now belongs to each character. It used to be one shared file, so after switching characters a Ready row was comparing itself against a different character's skill icons.

F11 can no longer be set as one of your keys. F11 reads your gear, so a row set to it would open and close your stats panel over and over while you played.

Tabbing away during a gear read no longer sends a stray key into whatever you tabbed to.
